subject: Hosted API evaluation — next steps, quickstart & rate limits
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: James Li <james.li@acmeai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API evaluation — next steps, quickstart & rate limits

Hi James —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap + recommended next steps for evaluating Redwood’s Hosted API (so your team can get a proof-of-concept running this week):

Recap (short):
- Hosted API: fastest to get started — no infra required, immediate SDKs & REST + trial credits. Good for early evaluation and low-to-medium throughput.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools for predictable high-throughput/low-latency production.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): for customers with strict data residency or air-gapped requirements.

Given your timeline (pilot end of Q1) and current traffic expectations (~5k monthly requests during evaluation), I recommend starting on Hosted API to validate prompts, latency, and cost. If you need higher sustained throughput or dedicated isolation we can scope a Dedicated trial after the POC.

Next steps to get you running on Hosted API:
1) I’ve attached a short quickstart PDF and a Postman collection to this thread.
2) Create a sandbox API key (I can provision one or you can self-serve in the console).
3) Sample curl to try a text-generation endpoint:

   curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate" 
     -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" 
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
     -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1","prompt":"Summarize company mission in one sentence","max_tokens":60}'

4) Default rate limits on Hosted (trial): 60 requests/min and ~10 concurrent streams for standard accounts. We can provision a higher sandbox quota (e.g., 300 req/min) for the POC — Dev is looped to handle that.

Security & data handling highlights:
- No customer data is used to train models by default; we can sign a short eval agreement to lock that down.
- Logs and request traces are retained for 30 days by default; we have enterprise configs for longer retention and audit exports.

If you’re good with this plan, let me know whether you want me to provision a sandbox key or if your infra team will sign up via the console. I’ll also schedule a 30 min tech sync with Dev if you want to go over the integration.

Thanks —
Marissa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: redwood-hosted-quickstart.pdf
Attachment: acme-postman-collection.json

From: James Li <james.li@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — next steps, quickstart & rate limits

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. A couple quick questions before we spin up the sandbox: 

1) Throughput: the POC will run batch scoring overnight (spikes to ~1500 req/min for short windows). Is that something the Hosted sandbox can support, or should we start with Dedicated?
2) Data residency & logs: we need logs retained for 90 days for audit; is that configurable on Hosted or would that push us to Private?
3) Billing/credits: do the trial credits cover the 2–3 week POC? If not, what’s the typical burn for a small POC?

Also, can you send a sandbox API key or give our infra user access to create one in the console? If you need an order of approvals I can loop in procurement.

—James
James Li
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme AI
james.li@acmeai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: James Li <james.li@acmeai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — next steps, quickstart & rate limits

Great questions — answers below and looping Dev to assist with the sandbox quota and any technical details.

1) Throughput: Hosted sandbox can be temporarily bumped to handle short spikes (1500 req/min) — we’ll need to provision a higher sandbox quota before your overnight batch runs. Dev, can you provision ~2k req/min for Acme’s sandbox for a 2-week window?

2) Logs/retention: Hosted supports configurable log retention up to 90 days on the enterprise add-on (no need to move to Private for 90-day retention). If you need exportable audit logs (S3 delivery) we can enable that as part of the POC.

3) Billing/credits: trial credits typically cover most small POCs. Estimated burn depends on tokens per request; if you share an average prompt size and expected tokens per response I can provide a rough cost estimate. For planning, we usually advise customers to budget $2k–$10k for a 2–3 week POC depending on volume and model size.

Sandbox key: I can provision a sandbox API key and drop it into a shared secret in your console (or email it to your infra owner). James — do you prefer DocuSign for a short eval agreement before we enable the higher sandbox quota?

Dev, assigning the action to provision the sandbox bump and confirm endpoint/streaming limits: acme-sandbox -> 2000 req/min, 20 concurrent streams for 14 days. Please reply with the sandbox key and any additional integration notes.

Thanks —
Marissa

--
Dev Patel (cc)
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
